answer: Locks are entered in sonnet, expire in raven, and inlet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 175 aliases therefore needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 802 identities would post 1516 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
